title: A house you can take apart: the teaser

chapters.title: A HOUSE YOU CAN TAKE APART
narration: A dome is a head. It wears hats -- and only the outside one is waterproof.

chapters.title: The frame is already on your land
narration: 2 trees, split into 120 wedges. No hubs, no jig.

chapters.title: The standard article wears a shower cap
narration: Every quilted layer buys the next cap a size up. A rigid shell fills at 4 and stops.

chapters.title: A $50 quilt, and a bigger cap for each
narration: The insulation is recycled clothing at $50 a layer, quilted at a kitchen table.

chapters.title: What it costs, all of it
narration: $12,036, and the whole invoice is on the page. $43 a square foot.

chapters.title: THE FULL FILM
narration: The whole film works every number on screen, and it is linked below.

chapters.title: YOUR TURN
narration: Back it, and tell us which price is wrong.
